title: Workspace controls
purpose: Common controls used throughout the application.

items.label: Documentation icon
items.description: Opens this page’s guide on the right. Following a menu link or opening a form changes the guide to that page or form; closing a form restores the page guide.

items.label: Resize documentation
items.description: Drag the panel’s left edge. With the separator focused, Left widens it and Right narrows it; hold Shift for larger steps. Home and End choose the allowed minimum and maximum. Width is limited to keep the panel usable in this window.

items.label: Close documentation
items.description: Use the close button or Escape while focus is in the panel. The preferred width and open/closed state are remembered for this account in this browser. Different browsers/devices have separate preferences; clearing browser storage resets them. When storage is unavailable the panel still works for the current page.

items.label: Narrow screens
items.description: The panel retains the preferred width when space allows and is bounded to the window with a small margin on narrow screens. Close it to return to the page; returning to a wider window restores the preferred desktop width.

items.label: Smart Roots / Find sample ID
items.description: The brand (the mark, Smart Roots and An OpenBGA project; the name alone on phones) returns to the workspace home. In the client portal the laboratory name takes its place. On staff pages, Find sample ID submits a search to Samples; its guide describes the search scope. Press Enter to search. On wide screens the laboratory name beside the brand identifies this deployment.

items.label: Menus and section tabs
items.description: Select a menu destination or a section tab to change pages. The current destination is marked when it appears in your menu, and keyboard focus has a visible outline. The staff sidebar shows destinations for the work your roles can perform, combines destinations when you hold several roles, and omits empty sections. Related record links and direct pages retain their existing access checks, so a readable record may have no sidebar destination for your role; no sidebar item is marked on that page. Portal destinations wrap onto another line on narrow screens; client portal navigation is unchanged.

items.label: Theme
items.description: The Theme menu offers Light, Dark and System. System follows the device preference. The chosen appearance is saved in this browser. After choosing an appearance, focus returns to the Theme button.

items.label: Account menu
items.description: Shows the signed-in name and laboratory roles or client. Change password and Two-factor authentication open account settings. A shared demonstration account, one whose password the deployment publishes on the sign-in page, shows a note instead of those two links: its password, email addresses and two-factor settings cannot be changed, opening those pages returns to the home page with a notice, and no password-reset link is mailed for it. Sign out ends the session.

items.label: Forms
items.description: Required fields are marked. Validation errors identify fields or the reason an action is blocked. After a failed page submission, focus moves to the first invalid field or the error summary when no field is invalid. Some forms open in a dialog; close/cancel leaves the underlying page. A direct form link opens the same dialog with its title as the page heading; Cancel returns to the related page or list. Sticky action buttons stay at the bottom while long forms scroll. Save applies the form only when server checks pass. A stale-edit message requires refreshing and checking current values before retrying.

items.label: Footer / Source code
items.description: Every staff, client portal, sign-in and error page ends with the product name, a Source code link and the AGPL-3.0-only licence. Source code opens the published source of the software this deployment runs, which the licence requires to be offered to its users; a deployment running modified code points it at its own source. It opens an external site and changes no records.

items.label: Every internal role
items.description: Dashboard, Training and Nonconformances are available to every active internal laboratory role. Training still limits whose records you may read, and each page checks its own actions.

items.label: Project manager
items.description: Clients, Projects, Quotes and Price lists support client and quotation work; Spreadsheet import loads clients and projects from CSV files. Client submissions, Chains of custody, Sample storage and Delivery schedule are shared with custodians. Samples is shared with custodians and reviewers.

items.label: Custodian
items.description: Client submissions, Chains of custody, Samples, Sample storage and Delivery schedule support intake, custody and delivery work.

items.label: Analyst and reviewer
items.description: Both roles see Preparation batches, Batches & QC, MDL studies, QC control charts, Lab overview, Inventory and Equipment. Analysts also see Worklist and Import mappings. Reviewers also see Samples for preservation assessment and Technical review. Individual actions still require the page’s permissions.

items.label: Subcontracted tests
items.description: Available to custodians, project managers, analysts and reviewers for their parts of subcontracted work.

items.label: Reports
items.description: Available to project managers, approvers and internal staff with explicit report-release permission. Release itself still requires that explicit permission and the report’s checks.

items.label: Admin
items.description: Admin includes the operational destinations of custodians, project managers, analysts and reviewers, plus Catalog, QC configuration, Laboratory profile, Spreadsheet import for every record type, Record retention and Announcements. The admin role does not grant report-release permission.

items.label: Accounts & roles
items.description: Available only to an active internal account with both Django staff and superuser status. The laboratory admin role alone does not grant account administration.

items.label: Search and filters
items.description: Apply narrows the server query, not only visible rows. The page-specific sections describe the searchable fields and implicit exclusions. Removing a filter chip clears that filter; Clear all resets the filter selection.

items.label: Sort and pages
items.description: Linked column headings change server-side ordering. Pagination moves through the filtered result set; the count describes that set. Choose Rows per page, then select Show to apply that page size and return to page 1 while keeping the other filters. Changing the selection alone does not reload the page.

items.label: Columns
items.description: Opens column visibility and order preferences. Use the controls to show/hide or move supported columns, or Reset columns to restore the defaults. Columns marked Always shown are locked. These preferences stay in this browser and do not change permissions or the underlying records.

sections.title: Submission size
paragraphs: The deployment limits the total size of a form submission, including files and form fields. The default limit is 12 MiB, leaving room for a supported 10 MiB upload and form overhead. A larger declared request is rejected with Request body is too large before the form is processed. Reduce the upload or submitted data and try again. Unsaved input may need to be entered again. Individual upload limits still apply.
